methods.notes: Secondary room-temperature standard; no neon lattice readings are included in Table S2. Exact reference EOS not bundled.

recalculation.notes: Raw KBr lattice parameters are retained for all compressed observations. Marker temperatures are tabulated explicitly. Secondary ruby/neon raw readings are not tabulated.

pressure_calibration.notes: KBr is the principal pressure standard. Room-temperature compression uses neon medium and ruby as an additional standard; source tables do not include ruby wavelengths or per-row marker attribution. Zero uncertainties at the reference row do not define infinite fitting weight.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: Complete single-phase source rows with published fixed choices. Unweighted pressure residuals and residual-scaled refit errors are diagnostics: source weights, coefficient confidence and covariance are unspecified. Parity denotes the ledger's numerical/combined-error criterion, not recovery of the authors' regression covariance. The Fe-16Si entry checks the 66-row thermal stage; the independent script also refits its 32-row static stage. See the [Fischer audit](literature-reproductions/fischer-2014-fesi.md).

fit.selection: 66 D03 observations above 300 K; source-staged gamma0 fit with the published 300 K coefficients fixed. The independent Fischer script also refits the 32-row static stage.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Table S5 and Text S1, page 2; 2012 official Table S2, source worksheet row numbers retained.
parameter_provenance.equation: Main equations (1)-(2); standard Vinet replaces BM3 for the alternatives according to Text S1. Thermal pressure is referenced to 300 K using the integrated-Gruneisen Debye-temperature law.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 6.799 cm^3/mol atoms; multiply by 16/0.602214076 for this cell. Measured and held fixed.
parameter_provenance.K0: Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 193.9 GPa. Fitted at 300 K then fixed in the thermal stage.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 4.91. Fitted at 300 K then fixed in the thermal stage.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Source-reported errors; confidence convention and covariance unspecified. Measured V0 errors remain recorded even when V0 is fixed.
parameter_provenance.fit_protocol: Diagnostic refits use unweighted pressure residuals; the source does not publish the numerical objective/weights or covariance. Published coefficients remain unchanged. The inherited 2012 protocol fits K0/K0_prime to 32 room-temperature observations, then gamma0 to 66 high-temperature rows with the published static coefficients held fixed; the independent script reports both stages.
parameter_provenance.gamma0: Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 1.9 ± 0.07, fitted.
parameter_provenance.theta0: 417 K, fixed to the adopted iron value.
parameter_provenance.n: One atom per fractional alloy formula; cell-to-formula normalization uses the explicit Z.

superseded_record_text.notes: Diagnostic refits use unweighted pressure residuals; the source does not publish the numerical objective/weights or covariance. Published coefficients remain unchanged. The inherited 2012 protocol fits K0/K0_prime to 32 room-temperature observations, then gamma0 to 66 high-temperature rows with the published static coefficients held fixed; the independent script reports both stages. The Fe–16Si Vinet alternative is a 2014 source-owned reanalysis of 2012 observations. Do not extrapolate the fixed structure or thermal EOS across phase coexistence boundaries.
